component.name: Cinema
component.summary: Your Jellyfin library, made for the couch

description.p: Cinema brings your Jellyfin films and series to a desktop or a Steam Deck, with the same look as Cinema for Android TV. Everything works with a game controller: browse, search with the on-screen keyboard, and play. Video plays in mpv, and how far you got is sent back to Jellyfin, so you can carry on from any device.
